question: Tata Institute of Fundamental Research was set up under the vision of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. Homi J Bhabha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Dr. Homi J. Bhabha developed the technology of underground nuclear explosion.

• Homi Jenhagir Bhabha was an Indian physicist who is often considered the father of the Indian nuclear program.

• In 1954, Bhabha founded a nuclear research center at Trombay which was later renamed the Bhabha Atomic Research Centre (BARC). A strong proponent of nuclear energy, Bhabha organized the first UN Conference on the Peaceful Uses of Atomic Energy in 1955. He was the head of India’s nuclear program until his death.

• Facts About Dr. C V Raman:__

 
 
• Name: Dr. Chandrashekhra Venkataraman or C.V. Raman
 
• Born on: 7 November 1888
 
• Place of Birth: Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu
 
• Father's Name: R. Chandrashekhara Aiyer
 
• Mother's Name: Parvathi Ammal
 
• Spouse Name: Lokasundari Ammal
 
• Died on: 21st November 1970
 
• Place of Death: Bangalore, India
 
• Discovery: Raman Effect
 
• Awards: Matteucci Medal, Knight Bachelor, Hughes Medal, Nobel Prize in Physics, Bharat Ratna, Lenin Peace Prize, Fellow of the Royal Society.
 
 
 
• **Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam**
 
 
• Dr APJ. Abdul Kalam was the 11th President of India.
 
• He served as the president of India from 2002 to 2007.
 
• He was the first scientist to become the president of India.
 
• He is well known as the "missile man of India".
 
• He was honored with the Bharat Ratna award in 1997.
 
• He died on 27th July 2015​
 
• "Wings of Fire" is the autobiography of Dr. APJ. Abdul Kalam
 
• Notable works are:
 
 
• The luminous spark.
 
• India 2020.
 
• Mission India
 
• Ignited Minds.
 
• Indomitable Spirit.
 
• Inspiring Thoughts.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Srinivasa Ramanujan**
 
 
• Srinivasa Ramanujan was born on 22 December 1887. 
 
• His birthay is celebrated as National Mathematics Day in India. 
 
• The day was first introduced by Manmohan Singh on 26 February, 2012. 
 
• The mathematician compiled about 3,900 results and nearly all his claims have been proven correct.
 
• Some of his famous results are the Ramanujan prime and theta function.
